title: ageratum corymbosum f. lactiflorum
intro: Ageratum corymbosum f. lactiflorum, commonly known as white alyssum, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ageratum corymbosum f. lactiflorum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect cells from oxidative damage. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties.
